customers_say: Customers find the water purifier excellent in quality and performance, with quick and perfect installation, and appreciate its premium design and taste control features. They consider it a great choice for daily use, particularly for small families. While some customers consider it good value for money, others feel it's not worth the price. The service receives mixed feedback, with some praising the customer support while others report terrible service.

reviews.author: Vigneshwar
reviews.title: Great Support and Product
reviews.body: The Purifier is good with much convenience and just that it would have been great if it had supported 5GHz connectivity instead of 2.4GHz..apart from that its totally recommendable.. The installation was provide by the Technician Mr. Dhanaraj (2004965) who was very professional and knowledgeable and was of great help..

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Good purification and features overall but slow dispensing
reviews.body: Good Thing: 1. Water quality is good as well taste 2. Stainless steel tank feels much more hygienic than standard plastic 3.Tracking TDS and filter life is very convenient 4. Long 2 years filter life means hassles service But the slow dispensing and minor design omissions male everyday usages a bit tedious.

reviews.title: Good but
reviews.body: Nice and also installation. Overall good for sure. Can go for it if you are looking for good purifier for yourself.

reviews.author: Reshma
reviews.title: Good Value for Money
reviews.body: Good water purifier with good water quality. It is easy to use and works well. Overall, I'm satisfied with the product and would recommend it.

reviews.author: Moosa
reviews.title: Excellent Product & Smooth Installation
reviews.body: Great product and excellent value for money. Water tastes clean and fresh, and the purifier works perfectly. Installation was quick and smooth. The technician was professional, explained everything clearly, and checked the TDS after installation. Very satisfied with the purchase. Highly recommended.
